description: Save a generated image, email or PDF as a template in the user's Second Brain, so the same inputs can be generated again from the generator or from chat. Takes the artifact_id a generator returned and a short name the user would recognise. Only the author's own draft can be saved. Returns the saved_template_id.

artifact_id.description: An artifact_id from a generator or list_artifacts.

name.description: A short name for the template.

name: save_as_template
title: Save as template
